status: Implemented and real-local-HTTP tested voiceover handoff and wired experimental audio-reference generation; model lip sync is not live-verified.

import.body: multipart/form-data: file (audio/wav) and manifest (JSON text). No other fields.

errors.400: Invalid or incomplete manifest/WAV, format or duration mismatch
errors.403: Non-loopback, foreign origin, proxy host or missing client header
errors.409: Same source job changed or an import is currently being processed
errors.413: Request body exceeds the bounded upload size

retrieve.effect: Returns the local asset and manifest; no provider call

composition.effect: Preview recording and transcript; explicit user action creates a new ad plan, preserving the old plan until chosen.

manifestRules.sourceJobId: 1–128 characters: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen; first character alphanumeric.
manifestRules.segmentsMeaning: Optional ordered non-overlapping fragment boundaries. These are not phoneme or word timestamps.
manifestRules.prohibited: Credentials, absolute paths, consent recordings and enrollment/reference recordings must not be sent.
manifestRules.emptyTranscript: text is a required string; empty is accepted for prepared recording transport. Agent talking packages require verified text.

audio.durationAuthority: Actual WAV PCM frame count, independently checked with ffprobe. Manifest must agree within 0.05s.
audio.storage: Local storage/references, Git-ignored; bytes are copied unchanged, no cloud upload.

response.importId: 64 hex characters; hash of source namespace and sourceJobId

idempotency: Same sourceJobId, normalized manifest and audio SHA256 returns the original import. Changed content with the same sourceJobId is rejected. Unknown outcome can be checked by deterministic importId; retrying identical content never generates video.

security.host: Actual HTTP Host must be127.0.0.1; matching Next-injected forwarded host/http proto allowed. Foreign authority or Forwarded rejected. Framework-internal req.url hostname is not the incoming authority.
security.origin: Origin must be absent or same-origin; foreign Sec-Fetch-Site rejected
security.cors: No CORS grants; a browser on another origin cannot supply the required custom header without an authorized preflight.
security.authenticationBoundary: Trusts processes on this computer. The client marker is not a secret or full authentication. Do not expose this server on LAN or use this local contract for hosted deployments.
security.paidActions: Import and preview invoke no API credentials, asset upload or generation. Existing price/Generate controls remain explicit.

originalVoiceover.description: Generate silent non-talking product footage using image references; replace clip audio with the imported soundtrack during local FFmpeg editing.
originalVoiceover.soundtrack: Uploaded WAV stays unchanged; final MP4 AAC is re-encoded, so final audio bytes are not bit-identical to source PCM.

seedanceReferenceAudio.body: input_references includes {type:'audio_url',audio_url:{url:publicHTTPS}} and image_url objects; generate_audio:true. Do not combine with first/last-frame mode.
seedanceReferenceAudio.meaning: Reference audio guides voice, timbre, dialogue or rhythm. It is not an immutable final-audio input with guaranteed per-word timings.
seedanceReferenceAudio.publication: Local asset needs an explicit public upload before model use. Current provider reference uploads use Higgsfield storage and require its server-side credentials.

exactLipSync.reason: No verified audio-preserving, externally driven lip-sync pipeline in this app. Prompt instructions and accepting audio_url do not prove exact reproduction.
exactLipSync.nextEvidence: Explicitly authorized paid canary with approved 5s voiceover, invented actor, one product image; inspect transcript, voice preservation, full timing and visible mouth alignment. Integrate a documented dedicated lip-sync provider if this does not meet acceptance criteria.

generation.durations: Live OpenRouter catalog: integers 4–30; imported audio: 5–30s.
generation.fractionalTiming: Keep source audio duration for editing. Round only the generation duration up to an integer, then trim the visual tail locally. No automatic speech-speed adjustment.
generation.preview: Existing Library and local MP4 media endpoints.
generation.claim: Terminal completed plus actual local output is required for success.

referenceLimits.authority: BytePlus Seedance 2.5 docs and existing validation, not a successful external-audio canary.
referenceLimits.portrait: Prior actual upstream error InputImageSensitiveContentDetected.PrivacyInformation. No real face reference by default; Google voice enrollment consent does not create a Seedance portrait authorization.

verification.nativeDesktopCanary: PASS2026-10-08:12s technical PCM, two identical handoffs, same import URL, GETdraft/page success, unchanged WAV SHA256. Test artifacts removed.
verification.paidExternalAudioCanary: Not run; no lip-sync quality claim.
